scope: Observed entry points only; OBS identifiers belong to this project. original_content_ids are populated only with separately recovered original identifiers in the stated namespace. These records do not establish total game-content counts.

entries.label: Opening cinematic presentation
entries.observation: Moving cinematic images were captured at multiple points; original stream boundaries and asset IDs are not recovered.

entries.label: Narrated prologue text
entries.observation: Original text pages progress along the recorded input route; script identity is unknown.

entries.label: Burning-location scripted scene
entries.observation: Original scene contains on-screen character dialogue and large machines; no battle-rule behavior is inferred.

entries.label: Opening room containing a painting
entries.observation: A guarded cold boot requests original field selector 14, initializes its original scene, and displays Fei beside the painting with dialogue. The later recorded Cross/Cross/Square route opens the menu; selector identity is corroborated by the original loader and source slots 634/635.

entries.label: Painting close-up and return
entries.observation: The observed close-up returns to room presentation after the recorded Cross input.

entries.label: Opening-room main menu
entries.observation: Square opens Status, Equip, Items, Abilities, Gear, File and Exit. Independently reproduced from cold boot through original field 14 with the reviewed painting-room scenario.

entries.label: Status at opening progression
entries.observation: Character statistics and Skills/Abilities/Equip choices are visible.

entries.label: Equipment at opening progression
entries.observation: Weapon and Accessories sections plus character-stat comparison are visible.

entries.label: Items at opening progression
entries.observation: An empty item list is visible.

entries.label: Abilities at opening progression
entries.observation: An ability list and description/resource panels are visible.

entries.label: Gear selection at opening progression
entries.observation: The recorded confirmation leaves the main menu visible; later availability is unknown.

entries.label: Memory-card management at opening progression
entries.observation: Card 1 and Card 2 slot grids plus Copy/Delete choices are visible; save creation and loading are not tested.

entries.label: Exit from opening-room menu
entries.observation: Exit returns to room presentation.

entries.label: Rocky outdoor path
entries.observation: Guarded cold boot requests original field selector 15; the initialized scene visibly contains Fei on a rocky path with a compass. Location name, original progression validity and player-control readiness are unresolved.

entries.label: Original Kernel MENU
entries.observation: The original Kernel MENU visibly lists Field, Battle, Worldmap, Battling, Menu and Movie. Label presence is not evidence that each target mode has been initialized or tested.

entries.label: Original Worldmap mode
entries.observation: Terrain, sky, a flying machine and minimap are visible; original terrain/location IDs remain unresolved.

entries.label: Original Worldmap mode
entries.observation: Terrain, sky, a flying machine and minimap are visible; original terrain/location IDs remain unresolved.

entries.label: Original Battling menu
entries.observation: Bonus Battling, Practice, Tutorial and Exit are four selectable entries; Bonus Battling is highlighted initially.

entries.label: Original Battling menu
entries.observation: Bonus Battling, Practice, Tutorial and Exit are visible.

entries.label: Bonus Battling match setup
entries.observation: Bonus Battling displays Player1 vs COM, Player1 vs Player2 and COM vs COM, plus match count, COM level and rubber-band options. Match behavior is untested.

entries.label: Practice Gear selection
entries.observation: Practice presents Weltall versus Vierge Gear selection; the exploratory capture filename is not the selected branch label.

entries.label: Battling Tutorial arena
entries.observation: Tutorial opens an arena with two Gears and instructional dialogue. Complete tutorial/minigame rules are not recovered.

entries.label: Exit from Battling
entries.observation: The explicitly selected Exit option returns to the original title presentation.

entries.label: Original New Game disc-request transition
entries.observation: The recorded cold boot explicitly selects New Game; the original program displays INSERT DISC 1. This identifies one original transition, without identifying a script opcode, event ID or disc-swap progression behavior.

entries.label: Original title disc-request dialog
entries.observation: Original New Game selection displays an INSERT DISC 1 dialog over the title. This UI observation shares a capture with the separately classified transition; it is not a second unique scene.

entries.label: Original populated bridge scene
entries.observation: The reviewed Square input from the original world-map presentation enters this populated bridge scene. Captured original field selector is 290; retail story access and a dedicated bridge-readiness adapter remain unknown.

entries.label: Original bridge main menu
entries.observation: A second Square opens Status, Equip, Items, Abilities, Gear, File and Exit in the original bridge scene. Visible menu output does not establish every branch or progression variant.

entries.label: Original bridge File/card-management UI
entries.observation: The original File branch displays Card 1 and Card 2 with fifteen outlined slots each, plus Copy and Delete. No card file is written or loaded, and no ordinary save format or save/load round trip is claimed.

entries.label: Original populated bridge scene
entries.observation: The reviewed Square input from the original world-map presentation enters this populated bridge scene. Captured original field selector is 290; retail story access and a dedicated bridge-readiness adapter remain unknown.

entries.label: Original bridge main menu
entries.observation: A second Square opens Status, Equip, Items, Abilities, Gear, File and Exit in the original bridge scene. Visible menu output does not establish every branch or progression variant.

entries.label: Original bridge File/card-management UI
entries.observation: The original File branch displays Card 1 and Card 2 with fifteen outlined slots each, plus Copy and Delete. No card file is written or loaded, and no ordinary save format or save/load round trip is claimed.

entries.label: Original room File/card-management UI
entries.observation: The original painting-room File branch displays two fifteen-slot card grids and Copy/Delete. This records save-related UI, not an executed card write, load or persistence test.
